snippet.title: Arkon Rhys Plays...Cabela's Adventure Camp Part 1 PS3
snippet.description:
*Child Friendly*

Hey all, this is a little series of videos showing me play Cabela's Adventure Camp from first trophy to platinum, it is a fun little game which involves a series of events that you can play inc. Biking, Kayaking, Whack a Mole.

It can be played with up to four players locally but this will stop you from getting trophies I found out later in a further video when I "Free Play" a couple of events.
And if you interested in the platinum side of the game, it took me 2 hours, 48 minutes to complete, and it would have been quicker had I known one of the Kayaking trophies unlocks on Kayaking 2...

Trophies:

Greedy - 9 mins, 01 secs
Speed Wheeler - 9 mins 11 secs
Shoot The Rapids - 11 mins 22 secs
Explorer - 13 mins 58 secs
Demolition Expert - 17 mins 23 secs
Memorizer - 30 mins 11 secs
Camp Star - 30 mins

Enjoy, Like, Subscribe...
Follow me on - https://twitter.com/ArkonRhys
